title: Owned piece
description: A numbered piece on the board belonging to one player. Extended through allOf by built-tile and built-link; never instantiated alone.

id.description: Per-match monotonic id from next-tile-id or next-link-id. The two counters are independent, so a tile and a link may share a number.

owner.description: Player id, "0" through "3". Colour is looked up through the seat, never stored here.
